    Peptides for weight loss, compared with the approved shots.

    Peptide Chooser editorial team. Checked 30 Oct 2026.

    Every claim links to its source.

    Two weekly shots are FDA approved for weight management, semaglutide (Wegovy) and tirzepatide (Zepbound), both on prescription. Online clinics also sell compounded copies, cheaper and not checked by the FDA batch by batch.

    Is it legal today?

    FDA status checked 30 Oct 2026

    A daily pill, orforglipron (Foundayo), is also FDA approved for weight management; it is not a peptide. Retatrutide and cagrilintide are still in trials and sold only by research-use shops. Below: what each option costs at the clinics we track, and which clinics have an FDA warning letter.

    FDA status of the peptides on this page, each with its source.

    PeptideStatusWhat that means
    RetatrutideNot approvedin clinical trials; no approved product 8
    Semaglutide (Ozempic, Wegovy)FDA approvedweight management and type 2 diabetes, prescription 2
    Tirzepatide (Zepbound, Mounjaro)FDA approvedweight management and type 2 diabetes, prescription 9

    Approved means the FDA approved a product containing it for a stated use. Not approved means no approved product exists; buying it for yourself is not a crime in the US, but nobody has checked what is in the vial. All substances

    Questions about peptides for weight loss

    What are the best peptides for weight loss?

    Two weekly shots are FDA approved for weight management, semaglutide (Wegovy) and tirzepatide (Zepbound), both on prescription. The options on this page: Compounded semaglutide or tirzepatide, pharmacy-made shot; Retatrutide, experimental shot, still in trials; CagriSema (cagrilintide with semaglutide), combination shot, still in trials; Semaglutide (Wegovy), weekly shot for weight loss; Tirzepatide (Zepbound), weekly shot for weight loss; Orforglipron (Foundayo), daily pill for weight loss, not a peptide; Liraglutide (Saxenda), daily shot for weight loss; Naltrexone-bupropion (Contrave), pill for weight loss, not a peptide; Orlistat (Alli), capsule without prescription, not a peptide.

    Are peptides for weight loss FDA approved?

    Not FDA approved; pharmacy-made: Compounded semaglutide or tirzepatide. Not approved; still in trials: Retatrutide and CagriSema (cagrilintide with semaglutide). FDA approved: Semaglutide (Wegovy), Tirzepatide (Zepbound), Orforglipron (Foundayo), Liraglutide (Saxenda), Naltrexone-bupropion (Contrave) and Orlistat (Alli). Each status has its source under "Is it legal today?".

    Do I need a prescription for peptides for weight loss?

    On prescription: Compounded semaglutide or tirzepatide, Semaglutide (Wegovy), Tirzepatide (Zepbound), Orforglipron (Foundayo), Liraglutide (Saxenda) and Naltrexone-bupropion (Contrave). Research use only: Retatrutide and CagriSema (cagrilintide with semaglutide). Over the counter: Orlistat (Alli).
